deployable.complete_pooling: One global Beta-Binomial posterior predictive fixed from the training block before future unsealing.
deployable.no_pooling: One player-specific Beta-Binomial posterior predictive fixed from the training block before future unsealing.

oracle_envelope.definition: For each player i, min(loss_complete_i(y_future_i), loss_no_pool_i(y_future_i)).
oracle_envelope.warning: The oracle envelope is not an executable forecasting policy and cannot be treated as a deployable baseline.

prohibitions: Do not convert PG004 from -1 to 1.
Do not relabel the oracle-envelope failure as a pass.
Do not use future outcomes to choose a deployable comparator.
Do not refit or alter prior, likelihood, sampler budget, thresholds, data, seeds or draws.
repair_claim: The frozen PG004 baseball posterior is non-inferior to each ex-ante executable simple pooling policy while remaining inferior to the hindsight oracle envelope. Therefore the parent contradiction localizes to unachieved ex-ante pooling-regime selection, not to cross-PPL incoherence or failure against either deployable simple baseline.

successor_research_object.name: Local Pooling Prior Router
successor_research_object.target: Predict ex ante which units require global shrinkage, local retention, or abstention.
successor_research_object.candidate_family: sum-zero adaptive local-scale prior or mixture-of-pooling experts governed by a training-only gate
successor_research_object.required_future_evidence: A new untouched natural future block; PG004 baseball outcomes cannot be reused as confirmatory evidence.
